name: Provideon Wire & Cable
old_description: was founded in 2022 under the leadership and expertise of our founder and president, who has over 30 years of experience in the low voltage wire and cable industry.
about:
Provideon Wire & Cable was founded in 2022 in Washington, Pennsylvania, by the former president of a third-generation Western Pennsylvania wire company. The founder drew on 30 years of industry experience and a family legacy passed down from his father and grandfathers to establish the business on principles of quality and service.

The company manufactures and distributes a range of low-voltage wire and cable products, including audio/video, life safety, networking, communications, and control cables. Product lines span Pro-Comm A/V, Life Safety Systems, Networking Cable, LV Communication + Control, Water Otter Cable, and cable accessories. The team brings over 350 years of combined experience in design, engineering, manufacturing, and sales, averaging 20 years per employee, and holds several U.S. patents and trademarks.

Provideon serves K-12 schools, colleges, houses of worship, commercial buildings, performing arts centers, stadiums, arenas, and factory floors—anywhere low-voltage communication and control cable is required. A network of internal and external sales representatives supports customers across these verticals.

The company's stated purpose is to deliver the highest quality wire and cable through best-in-class service and quick delivery of in-stock products, guided by a QVES mission (Quality, Value, Environment, Social) and four commitments to Customers, Coworkers, Corporate, and Community.
